name: @pipeworx/mcp-noaa-spc

tools.name: mesoscale_discussions
tools.description: Recent mesoscale discussions list (as text page).

tools.name: storm_reports
tools.description: Fetch NOAA SPC preliminary storm reports CSV for a given date (YYMMDD, default today UTC) filtered by kind: tornado, wind, hail, or filtered (combined). Returns raw CSV with time, location, magnitude, and remarks.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-noaa-spc forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the noaa-spc pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
